::: {#rem-equivalence-notation}
#### Notation for logical equivalence

By @exr-absorption, $P \lor (P \land Q) \equiv P$.

$A \equiv B$ is a claim about $A$ and $B$,
not a new proposition built from them with a logical connective (@def-logical-connective).
Some books write $A \Leftrightarrow B$ or $A \iff B$ for it instead,
which is easy to confuse with the biconditional (@def-iff);
these notes use $\equiv$.

:::
